## maude MAUDE_VERSION

Maude Light: a lightweight WSL2 sandbox for agentic coding on Windows (Ubuntu 26.04 default, 24.04 with `-Noble`).

### Artifacts

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `maude.exe` | Windows launcher and TUI |
| `maude.exe.sha256` | SHA-256 checksum |

### Quick Start

Install Maude Light with one PowerShell command; see the [Maude Light README](https://github.com/dirkpetersen/maude/blob/main/light/README.md#install) for the command.

See the [Maude Light README](https://github.com/dirkpetersen/maude/blob/main/light/README.md) and the [maude.exe guide](https://github.com/dirkpetersen/maude/blob/main/docs/windows-exe.md) for full documentation.
